evidence: Al2O3 films were deposited at 250 ° C either using H2O or using O3, 90 ALD cycles were applied for both oxygen sources leading to a film thickness range of 7 – 8 nm; reactor base pressure was /H110110.3 Torr. Film’s ALD cycles were always composed of (i) TMA injection (0.015 s), (ii) N2 purge (8s), (iii) oxygen precursor injection (0.015 s for H2O and 0.025 s for O3/H20850, and (iv) N2 purge (8s).
